data.description:
Build a behavioral CONFORMANCE ORACLE that asserts total parity of the write ops across the lib, CLI, and MCP adapters, so surface drift is caught mechanically without an LLM, without a change-detector, and without a manually-maintained NxM matrix. This is the durable form of the validated prototype (docs/experiments/write_parity_oracle_prototype.py).

PATTERN (Pattern B, proven in OSS: DB-API / SQLAlchemy dialect compliance, CommonMark spec suite, WSGI/ASGI validators, S3/k8s conformance suites): ONE transport-agnostic contract = a table of (op, inputs, expected accept/reject + expected effect). Run every case through each adapter against a temp store; classify ACCEPTED / REJECTED(rule) / PARAM_NOT_EXPOSED. A divergence between adapters on the same case fails the suite. It tests BEHAVIOR (incl. runtime conditional-required rules: close_class required iff bug-close; reason conditionally required per REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES) that signature/shape generation provably cannot express.

ZERO EXCEPTIONS: no capability flags, no allow-list. Achieved by (a) force allowed on all surfaces and (b) removing deprecated surface (force_close) rather than exempting it (sibling tickets). New adapter => rerun same suite; new op => one spec row; drift in ANY adapter fails automatically.

Why NOT Pattern A (generate the surfaces): behavior is already single-sourced (all surfaces funnel into composer.create_core / transition_compute / claim_compute); surfaces carry irreducible hand-written value (LLM-facing MCP docstrings, CLI ergonomics); generation cannot express the runtime rules; regenerating CLI/MCP risks user/agent-visible contract breaks (flag spellings, exit code 10, LLM tool schema).

SCOPE: promote the prototype into a real test (tests/ + a shared contract table); cover transition/claim/create write ops; reuse the tests' _FakeMCP/_FakeCtx capture + the interfaces sandbox-repo bootstrap; add the CLI adapter (invoke the CLI verb path). PORTABILITY: no CI-provider-specific triggers; runs as an ordinary pytest.

ACCEPTANCE:
- A shared contract table drives all three adapters; adding an op = one row.
- Suite is RED against today's tree (MCP gaps reason/caused_by/force) and GREEN once the MCP-parity sibling lands.
- Runtime rules (close_class-required, reason-required) are asserted behaviorally on every adapter.
- No false-positives on intended internals (source/return_alias/_creation_channel/repo_root are adapter-bound, not contract params).
- make lint + typecheck green.
data.title: Behavioral conformance oracle for write-op parity across lib/CLI/MCP adapters
